Faith: Ask for firm confidence in God and practical obedience.
Salvation: Thank God for His grace and respond to the gospel.
Repentance: Ask for genuine change of heart and conduct.
Forgiveness: Pray for grace to forgive others as Christ forgives.
Overcoming Unforgiveness: Ask God to remove bitterness and help you seek peace wisely.
Prayer: Ask the Lord to teach you to pray faithfully.
Intercession: Pray thoughtfully for your family, church and nations.
Discipleship: Ask for courage and endurance in following Jesus.
Destiny & Purpose: Ask for wisdom to serve God faithfully in daily decisions.
Holiness: Pray for a life set apart to God.
Righteousness: Seek God’s righteousness in your choices.
Marriage: Pray for love, responsibility and faithfulness in families.
Christian Family: Pray for patience, kindness and understanding at home.
Baptism of the Holy Ghost: Ask for the Holy Spirit’s enabling to witness of Christ.
The Holy Trinity: Worship the Father, Son and Holy Spirit.
Consecration: Dedicate your whole life to serving God.
Commitment: Pray for steadfast commitment to Christ.
Sacrifice: Ask for generosity and willingness to do good.
Surrender to God: Seek humility in accepting God’s will.
Love for God: Pray that love for God directs your actions.
End-Time Army of Christ: Ask for perseverance, character and faithfulness in service.
Revival: Pray for renewed devotion to God and His Word.
Spiritual Power: Seek power to live faithfully and testify of Christ.
The Invisible Church: Thank God that He knows those who belong to Him.
The Rapture of the Saints: Pray for watchfulness and encouragement in Christ.
Evangelism: Pray for compassion in sharing the gospel.
Soul Winning: Ask for wisdom and love in witnessing.
Spiritual Growth: Ask to grow in grace and knowledge of Christ.
Obedience: Ask for strength to obey Christ from love.
Fruit of the Spirit: Ask the Spirit to develop godly character.
Gifts of the Spirit: Pray for wisdom to use gifts to serve others.
Fasting: Seek sincerity and humility in spiritual disciplines.
Waiting on God: Pray for patience and renewed strength.
Spiritual Warfare: Pray for spiritual steadfastness and discernment.
Christian Integrity: Ask for honesty in words and actions.
Overcoming Temptation: Pray for wisdom to choose what is right.
Divine Guidance: Commit your decisions to God in prayer.
Eternal Life: Thank God for His promise through Jesus Christ.
Readiness for Christ’s Return: Ask for a faithful, watchful Christian life.
Hope: Ask God to fill you with hope and peace.
Patience: Pray for maturity when facing difficulties.
Mercy: Pray to practice mercy and justice.
Gratitude: Give thanks to God in all circumstances.
Worship: Worship the Lord with reverence and joy.
Unity of Believers: Pray for peace and love in the body of Christ.
Comfort in Trials: Ask for comfort and strength to encourage others.
Stewardship: Ask to use your gifts responsibly.
Compassion: Seek kindness to people in need.
Contentment: Pray for gratitude in changing circumstances.
God’s Word: Ask for understanding and obedience while reading Scripture.
